status_notice: Implemented means an executable bounded experiment exists, not scientific validation. Per-run outputs contain actual outcomes.

budget.scope: discretionary training/prototypes; shared references, confirmation, testing and reporting separately bounded

hypotheses.name: Normalization
hypotheses.mechanism: Replace half-normalized historical pair with normalized Gauss2 at equal operator/support.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Normalization recovers substantial gain if amplitude is the main explanation.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Same nodes and transforms; historical conditioner overhead stays explicitly labeled.
hypotheses.advance_if: Establish attribution regardless of sign; retain half rule only as historical control.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Do not claim conditioning benefit from this pair.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Fit only what is necessary
hypotheses.mechanism: Fit amplitude, node, joint scalar, four-coefficient tanh-linked affine feature response and full conditioner separately, matching scalar gain bounds and objective.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: State dependence matters only if full model beats strongest simple matched fitted rule.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Feature cost and fit/tuning cost retained.
hypotheses.advance_if: Ratio >=1.1; CI95 lower>1; coverage regression<=.05; fresh cohort.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Equivalent effective responses or no benefit beyond simple fit: prefer simpler rule.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished
hypotheses.implementation_scope: Scalar and four-coefficient tanh-linked affine controls use least-squares initialization, then bounded deterministic fits of the same scaled MSE+0.1*maximum-square objective and gain interval (0.25,1.75) as the neural conditioner. Ridge affects initialization only; fit convergence and offline work remain explicit. A simple fitted control can legitimately explain the conditioner benefit.

hypotheses.name: Quadrature and compression
hypotheses.mechanism: Match physical core; cross two/four nodes and output/full support with pure input-compression ablation.
hypotheses.primary_metric: retained/full RMS, joint max/RMS pass, time
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Precompression loses useful signed interactions; more nodes help only if quadrature error dominates.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: More nodes/retained modes can increase transforms/memory.
hypotheses.advance_if: Representation ratio>=1.5 in declared pure comparison; CI95 lower>1; preserve easy-case harm reporting.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Refinement has no useful effect or filtered variant harms strongest full component.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Equal endpoint opportunity and backbones
hypotheses.mechanism: Identical final-time schedule menus and DF/RF/ETDRK4 controls.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Some old classical advantage may be menu-dependent; backbone gains are separately attributable.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Evaluate one/two/four/eight steps for all, retain setup and all failures.
hypotheses.advance_if: Matched target/menu/reference; fixed validation selection separate from posthoc truth envelope.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Time/target mismatch or unresolved teacher invalidates a comparison, not whole portfolio.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished
hypotheses.implementation_scope: Validation schedule costs may be per-field batched while confirmation latency is single-field. Frozen transfer is valid but not proof of optimal schedule for every deployment batch.

hypotheses.name: Credible neural control
hypotheses.mechanism: Retain full-grid local FNO path; inspect initialization, feature/loss scaling, gradients and optimizer alternatives.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: An optimized local FNO may narrow prior gap; if it cannot fit tiny data baseline adequacy is unresolved.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Training/tuning time and capacity exposed; update count alone is not compute fairness.
hypotheses.advance_if: Baseline learns and receives declared training opportunity; official reproduction required for paper claim.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Saturation absent or zero coverage means unresolved competitive claim, not automatic TDN victory.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Identifiability
hypotheses.mechanism: Inspect effective gain/correction response and node-amplitude sensitivity, not only raw parameters.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Several parameter vectors may encode the same amplitude correction.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Cheap fixed development probes and saved parameter reports.
hypotheses.advance_if: Stable additional response structure predicts held-out errors beyond scalar fit.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Redundant nonidentifiable parameters: normalize/reparameterize or distill.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Richer global features
hypotheses.mechanism: Add variance/gradient/spectral summaries only where old features alias useful decisions.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Old-feature twins may require distinct gains that inexpensive new summaries distinguish.
hypotheses.advance_if: Useful>=1.1 error ratio plus bounded harm beyond strongest scalar control.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: No useful conditional signal or extra cost exceeds benefit.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Learn around normalized anchor
hypotheses.mechanism: Explicit learned residual of strong normalized quadrature.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Anchoring improves optimization/generalization and protects easy behavior.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Residual evaluation must be timed independently.
hypotheses.advance_if: Beats strongest contained normalized rule with reference resolved.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Only constant rescaling learned or worst-case/mean harm rises.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Band-dependent adaptation
hypotheses.mechanism: Form interactions before projection and allow distinct retained-band gains.
hypotheses.primary_metric: bandwise error, whole-field max/pass, full cost
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Different bands need distinct correction strengths in specific regimes.
hypotheses.advance_if: Improvement beyond strongest scalar and no destructive filtering interaction.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: No meaningful band heterogeneity or cost/rollout regressions.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Complete cost and profiling
hypotheses.mechanism: Profile frozen variants; evaluate fair caching/fusion/precision/batching only with parity.
hypotheses.primary_metric: accuracy-qualified paired speed; latency tails/memory/total costs
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Transforms/launches/features, rather than MLP parameter count, dominate workloads.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Charge warm/cold setup, ref/training, rejection and fallback when present.
hypotheses.advance_if: Speed>=1.2; CI95 lower>1; feasible>=.95; coverage regression<=.05; matched workload.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: No margin: block policy stacks and retain negative cost result.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Learning distribution and error target
hypotheses.mechanism: Dimensionless defect-scaled learning; teacher uncertainty floors; nested subsets; separate track and shift diagnostics.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Some apparent data failure is optimization or teacher/noise mismatch rather than insufficient capacity.
hypotheses.advance_if: Held-out advantage at frozen budgets; fresh fields/parameters/grids/horizons assessed separately.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Training-only gains or reference floors dominate: revise objective/distribution in new development protocol.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished

hypotheses.name: Amortized time kernel
hypotheses.mechanism: Encode signed spectral pairs once; evaluate/interpolate physical kernel over repeated horizons.
hypotheses.primary_metric: kernel parity, PDE accuracy and query-count break-even
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Encoding can repay its cost for enough same-state horizons.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Encoding/storage/refresh/output reconstruction charged; pair enumeration may be quadratic.
hypotheses.advance_if: Parity<=1e-10; surrogate relativeRMSE<=.001; break-even<=32 queries then full-PDE qualification.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: No positive asymptotic savings, bad h->0 behavior, invalid cache reuse or memory blowup.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished
hypotheses.implementation_scope: One-dimensional constant-generator second-Picard quadratic response. Not the full logistic-background DF defect or complete PDE. One synthetic development field; classical DOP853 dense output solves the same lifted response task.

hypotheses.name: Coarse twin information test
hypotheses.mechanism: Construct same coarse state with distinct unresolved interactions; test added instantaneous statistics/history.
hypotheses.primary_metric: coarse-state mismatch and unresolved derivative/trajectory separation
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Memoryless coarse state alone cannot distinguish twin futures.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Cost-saving potential only if fine work can eventually be omitted; no current solver claim.
hypotheses.advance_if: Twin mismatch<=1e-12, separation>1e-8, augmented/history RMSE ratio<=.5; fresh-twin followup.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Added state still aliases response, history unavailable or unstable: reject closure representation.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished
hypotheses.implementation_scope: Finite 1D Galerkin twin states; prediction of first complex retained Fourier coefficient from synthetic short backward-generated history. History acquisition charged; independent RK4 reference crosscheck on declared subset. Not a deployable general closure.

hypotheses.name: Select work before products
hypotheses.mechanism: Initial-feature deterministic/fitted decisions choose interaction support/order; distill simple behavior.
hypotheses.primary_metric: relative correction error and complete selector+selected cost
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Cheap summaries predict unnecessary expensive products in some regimes.
hypotheses.computational_consequence: Selection, failures and all selected work charged; oracle remains separate.
hypotheses.advance_if: Relative error<=.01 and total speedup>=1.10, then full-PDE max/pass qualification.
hypotheses.stop_or_revise_if: Phase twins fool selector or selection overhead erases savings.
hypotheses.novelty_claim: new project experiment only; literature priority unestablished
hypotheses.implementation_scope: Conjugate-mode selection before second-Picard pair products on smooth/sparse/rough development fields; not a full PDE accuracy-certified policy. Additional eight-phase equal-magnitude audit is correlated descriptive evidence with a separate NA gap verdict, not independent-field confirmation.
